definitions.explanation: Favorable circumstances or success by chance.

examples.japanese: {幸運|こううん}⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧
{幸運|こううん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{祈|いの}ります→祈る：01198_inoru⟧。
{幸運|こううん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦だった→だ：09496_da⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦けが→けが：00787_kega⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦なかった→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: Fortunately, despite it being a major accident, there were no injuries.

notes:
{幸運|こううん} means good luck or fortune, referring to favorable circumstances that bring success by chance. Functions as both a noun and na-adjective.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {幸運|こううん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{祈|いの}る→祈る：01198_inoru⟧: to wish good luck
- {幸運|こううん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧: fortunately, luckily
- {幸運|こううん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{恵|めぐ}まれる→恵まれる：12619_megumareru⟧: to be blessed with good luck
- {幸運|こううん}⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: a lucky person

NA-ADJECTIVE USAGE:
{幸運|こううん}⟦な→な：09497_na⟧ + noun describes someone or something as lucky.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {幸運|こううん}: good luck (positive outcome)
- ⟦{不運|ふうん}→不運：00049_fuun⟧: bad luck, misfortune
- ⟦{運|うん}→運：02143_un⟧: luck, fortune (neutral)
